question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Appraise
solution: The correct answer is '**Assess**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Meanings of all the words given:-** • **Appraise**: to judge the value or quality of somebody/something. (किसी वस्‍तु आदि का मूल्‍यांकन करना) • **Revolt**: to protest in a group, often violently, against the person or people in power. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या सत्ताधारी के विरुद्घ सामूहिक विद्रोह करना) • **Assess**: to judge or form an opinion about something. (राय बनाना, आँकना) • **Neglect**: to give too little or no attention or care to somebody/something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की उपेक्षा करना) • **Amend**: to change something slightly in order to make it better. (बेहतर बनाने के लिए ज़रा-सा सुधारना) From the meanings given above, it is clear that '**assess**' is the correct **synonym **to '**appraise**'. 40:Tb3f, The correct answer is '**DCBA**'.
